clean_options.name: Solar
clean_options.contribution: Distributed or grid-scale daytime renewable generation.
clean_options.evidence: Massachusetts programs and ISO-NE's proposed-resource context include solar.
clean_options.limitation: Weather-variable; site output requires qualified resource and equipment data.

clean_options.name: Onshore and offshore wind
clean_options.contribution: Renewable generation that can complement solar production profiles.
clean_options.evidence: Wind is a leading proposed-resource category and part of state policy direction.
clean_options.limitation: Proposed or procured capacity is not operating generation.

clean_options.name: Hydroelectric supply
clean_options.contribution: Scheduled or dispatchable low-carbon electricity supply.
clean_options.evidence: ISO-NE reports regional clean-resource procurements that include hydro.
clean_options.limitation: Imports and contracts must be distinguished from in-state generation.

clean_options.name: Nuclear
clean_options.evidence: Included in Massachusetts' 2026 all-resources policy direction.
clean_options.limitation: Low-carbon but not renewable; project economics and status require separate review.

clean_options.name: Geothermal
clean_options.contribution: Firm generation or building thermal electrification, depending on technology.
clean_options.limitation: Electric generation and ground-source building systems are different use cases.

clean_options.name: Battery storage
clean_options.contribution: Moves electricity across time to support peaks and resilience.
clean_options.evidence: Massachusetts reported 1,621 MWh installed and 13,289 MWh in its pipeline.
clean_options.limitation: Storage is not generation; emissions depend on the charging source.

clean_options.name: Demand flexibility
clean_options.contribution: Shifts or reduces consumption during constrained periods.
clean_options.evidence: ISO-NE reported 408 MW of capacity and 10 GWh of reductions in 2024.
clean_options.limitation: Performance depends on baselines, participation, and measurement rules.

clean_options.name: Energy efficiency
clean_options.contribution: Avoids energy use and can reduce infrastructure needs.
clean_options.evidence: Included in ISO-NE forecasts and Massachusetts load-management planning.
